newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs easier, carries over weakness from LIFFE.
newsitem.headline: JGBs easier, carries over weakness from LIFFE.

text.p: The key September 10-year Japanese government bond futures contract was easier in early trade on Wednesday as it carried over weakness from LIFFE and due to selling of U.S. Treasuries overnight.

"JGBs fell to end at around 124.20 on LIFFE overnight, and liquidation of long positions by those who had bought at above 124.30 is causing JGBs to falter," said a trader for a city bank's securities unit.
JGBs showed little initial reaction to a sharp rise in Japan's may trade surplus to 738.27 billion yen, traders said.
The September stood at 124.27 as of 0030 GMT, down slightly from the previous day's close of 124.30.
The benchmark 182nd JGB yield stood at 2.350 percent as of 0032 GMT, up slightly from Tuesday's close of 2.345 percent.
